Hi Alice / Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier - really helpful to understand Acme's use case and where Private (VPC) deployment makes the most sense. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: you want predictable throughput, private networking + KMS integration, and an audit trail for model inference.
- Next step: schedule a 60-minute architecture review / technical deep dive with our Solutions Architect to walk through network topology, peering options, and security posture.

Suggested slots (PDT):
- Tue Mar 16: 10:00-11:00
- Thu Mar 18: 14:00-15:00
- Fri Mar 19: 09:00-10:00

Please let me know which slot works best and who from your infra/security team will join. I'm looping in Marissa (Solutions Architect) and Nikhil (SRE lead) to cover architecture and networking.

Attached: Mutual Action Plan (stub) and network_requirements.xlsx - please fill the spreadsheet with any IP ranges or firewall constraints you already know; it will speed the review.

Proposed agenda (60m):
1) Goals & constraints (5m)
2) Private/VPC deployment options & recommended topology (20m)
3) Network connectivity (peering, egress rules, NAT, DNS) (15m)
4) Security & compliance (KMS, audit logs, data flow) (10m)
5) Next steps / action items (10m)

If you prefer, you can pick a time directly via this scheduler link: https://redwood.app/scheduler/meet?cid=acme-123

Thanks,
